_about: HockeyShift / DigitalShift league and tournament sites. client_service_id is in each site's window.config; the API (web.api.digitalshift.ca) needs a ticket from POST /login and the site's Origin. league: the stats league id. comp: header competition words (lower case). names: site spelling -> header spelling. context: words added to the league name for the scorer (age group when the league has one). strip: regex removed from site team names (sponsors).
